findings.title: Introduces confusing 'demo patient profile' jargon
findings.evidence_quote: to help you book an appointment. I'll need to create a demo patient profile for you Can I have your first and last name?
findings.what_happened: The agent introduced an undefined term ('demo patient profile') that the caller had already flagged as confusing in the prior turn, without ever explaining what it meant.
findings.why_it_matters: Unexplained internal/system terminology can make a real patient worried their information is being handled incorrectly or that they are being enrolled in something unintended.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should have simply proceeded to collect the caller's name to book the appointment without referencing internal system labels like 'demo' profile.

findings.title: Fabricates an appointment never established in the call
findings.evidence_quote: You have an office visit already scheduled for Thursday, September 10 at 2PM. Because of this, I can't book another office visit of the same type right now. Would you like to reschedule your current appointment to Wednesday instead?
findings.what_happened: The agent asserted the caller already had a scheduled office visit for Thursday, September 10 at 2PM, a detail that never appeared anywhere earlier in the conversation, and which the caller explicitly denied ('No, I don't have anything scheduled yet').
findings.why_it_matters: Presenting a fabricated or contradicted fact as established truth could block a real booking, confuse the patient about their own records, and erode trust in the system's accuracy.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should not have introduced an appointment that was never mentioned or confirmed, and should have accepted the caller's correction that no appointment existed, or checked the actual record and reported honestly if uncertain.

findings.title: Call ends without a confirmed appointment or time offered
findings.evidence_quote: Would you like to move that appointment to Wednesday? Or do you want me to double check anything else?
findings.what_happened: Despite the caller's repeated requests to book (or check availability for) an appointment, the call ends after a readback confirmation with no appointment time offered, no availability given, and no booking confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: The caller's core objective—booking an appointment—was never accomplished, meaning the call failed its primary purpose despite consuming significant time.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should have provided concrete available times for Wednesday and confirmed a booked appointment before the call ended.
